summary: Round r1 (restricted network; web-search budget exhausted, data hosts blocked). Fifteen leads recorded, most reused from sibling tasks and upstream agents: CEA/MoP/CERC cross-border instruments that govern wheeling Nepali power to Bangladesh through India, NEA annual reports, MoFA Nepal, the NTIP agreement register, the India transit-treaty compilation, NITDB and customs statistics, SASEC, the UN Awaza Programme of Action, ICRIER and a World Bank Bhutan CEM as comparator. Q1 (Nepal-India-Bangladesh power trade): four components defined (agreement, Indian approval, delivered flows, announced expansion); none has a retrieved primary record, all pending. Q2 (transit rights to Bangladeshi ports): legal basis vs use-in-practice separated; both pending. Pakistan and Bhutan: no bilateral lead beyond MoFA landing page and SAARC-level instruments (see 17D). No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Q1: Status of the Nepal-India-Bangladesh power trade arrangement (agreement, Indian approval, delivered energy, announced expansion) is pending.
findings.note: Agreement text/signing record, CEA approval, NEA sales by destination FY2024/25-FY2025/26.

findings.claim: Energy delivered from Nepal to Bangladesh and realised tariff.
findings.note: NEA annual report sales tables; Bangladesh Power Development Board import record for cross-check (not in catalog).

findings.claim: Q2: Legal basis of Nepal's access to Bangladeshi ports (bilateral transit agreement/protocol and the India transit leg) is pending.
findings.note: Texts of Nepal-Bangladesh transit instruments; India transit protocol provisions on Bangladesh-bound traffic.

findings.claim: Q2: Actual use of Bangladeshi ports and land routes for Nepal's trade (cargo volumes by route and year).
findings.note: NITDB/customs route-level data; absence of data will be reported as a gap, not zero.

findings.claim: Nepal trade with Bangladesh, Bhutan and Pakistan by HS chapter, Nepal FY.
findings.note: Customs FY2022/23 trade book (17C-L11) and later books.

findings.claim: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.

Bangladeshi port access is carried in scenarios as an alternative route only when an in-use record exists; otherwise it is a scenario option with stated legal and physical preconditions (Indian transit leg, rail/road permissions).

data_gaps: Text or official signing record of the Nepal-India-Bangladesh power sale arrangement.
Bangladesh Power Development Board and Bangladesh commerce/shipping ministry sources are not in the source catalog.
Route-level cargo data for Nepal's use of Chittagong/Mongla and Bangladesh land routes.
Nepal-Pakistan and Nepal-Bhutan bilateral trade/transport instruments beyond SAARC (no leads).
Bhutan-specific evidence on BBIN and on its own India power-trade framework only via comparator (World Bank CEM).

assumptions.text: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
Trilateral transactions depend on Indian approvals under the same MoP/CEA/CERC framework documented by 17A; 17C does not duplicate that framework but records transaction-specific approvals.
Bangladesh FY (July-June) and Nepal FY (mid-July) are treated as distinct; conversion documented when flows are compared.

challenges.text: Add catalog ids for Bangladesh Power Development Board, Bangladesh Bank/Ministry of Commerce, Chittagong and Mongla port authorities, and Bhutan's Ministry of Energy/Druk Green; 17C cannot otherwise cite Bangladesh- or Bhutan-side records.

Trilateral (Bangladesh-destined) sales should be a separate segment in the electricity export series (X16), not merged with Indian exchange or bilateral sales, because pricing and approval regimes differ.
Bangladeshi port routes should enter transit modelling (X08) only with an in-use cargo record; otherwise model as an option with Indian transit-leg preconditions.

uncertainty: Very high for r1. No primary record of the trilateral arrangement or of Bangladesh port usage was located; the component list is provisional and partly named from domain knowledge. Bangladeshi-side sources are absent from the catalog, so cross-validation is currently impossible.

trilateral_power_status.question: Q1 What is the status of Nepal-India-Bangladesh power trade arrangements?

components.component: Tripartite/trilateral power sale agreement (Nepal seller, Indian trading intermediary, Bangladesh buyer)
components.note: Named from general domain knowledge as a document to locate; no lead located in r1 (web-search budget exhausted, data hosts blocked); existence, title and date must be verified from the primary text.
components.evidence_needed: Signed agreement text or NEA/BPDB/Indian intermediary record of signing; parties, term, tariff basis

components.component: Indian regulatory approval for wheeling Nepal power to Bangladesh
components.evidence_needed: CEA designated-authority approval record; applicable CERC provisions

components.component: Physical flows actually delivered to Bangladesh
components.evidence_needed: NEA annual report sales by destination (FY2024/25, FY2025/26); Bangladesh-side import record

components.component: Announced expansion (additional volumes, direct Nepal-Bangladesh transmission link, Bangladesh investment in Nepali hydropower)
components.note: Named from general domain knowledge as a document to locate; no lead located in r1 (web-search budget exhausted, data hosts blocked); existence, title and date must be verified from the primary text.
components.evidence_needed: MoU/agreement texts; distinguish announcements from signed contracts

trilateral_power_status.method: Classify each component using 17C-A1; approvals, contracts and delivered energy recorded separately; Bangladesh FY (July-June) vs Nepal FY (mid-July) differences documented.

port_access_status.question: Q2 What transit rights to Bangladeshi ports exist in practice?

legal_basis.instrument: Nepal-Bangladesh trade and transit agreement(s) and protocol(s)
legal_basis.note: Named from general domain knowledge as a document to locate; no lead located in r1 (web-search budget exhausted, data hosts blocked); existence, title and date must be verified from the primary text.

legal_basis.instrument: India-Nepal Treaty of Transit provisions for movement through Indian territory to/from Bangladesh
Multilateral LLDC transit principles (Awaza Programme of Action)

in_practice.evidence_needed: Cargo volumes of Nepal's third-country trade routed via Chittagong/Mongla (by year); bilateral trade via the Kakarbhitta-Banglabandha route; rail routing (Rohanpur-Singhabad or other) usage records

port_access_status.method: Right-on-paper (legal basis) vs right-in-use (cargo record) are reported separately; absence of cargo records is reported as a gap, not as zero use.

bhutan_pakistan_notes.note: Bhutan: comparator for hydropower export to India (17C-L15) and BBIN participant; Pakistan: relevant only through SAARC instruments (17D). No bilateral leads located.

X16.contribution: Trilateral (Bangladesh) segment of electricity exports, approvals and prices

X30.contribution: Bangladesh/Bhutan-related regional arrangements (BBIN) feeding 17D's status table
